title: Maltorius' Missive
wikitext:
'''Maltorius' Missive''' drops from [[Overseer Bragordi]].

==As a quest objective==
* {{questlong|Alliance|33|The Slavemakers}}

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Your initiative to expand into the bordering lands of Northwind proved to be a complete success, Bragordi! These new gnoll slaves you have brought with you are doing excellent work in the [[Slag Pit]]; resilient, pain resistant and most of all: They know how to use those muscles! Compared to the human and Bronzebeard slaves crying for mercy and whatnot, they are much more efficient and pushed productivity tenfold!
----
If I remember correctly, you have set your eyes on the local kobolds and already started putting some of them to work. Should their natural affinity to digging prove useful, ship them directly to the Searing Gorge. I don't need any more humans of the sort. I've grown a liking to these critters and their animalistic strength! I expect steady reports from you.

For the glory of Ragnaros - [[Overseer Maltorius]]
}}
